safe_route_rules: Classify task by intended document/evidence and owner, not only title or phrase
Enterprise and academic family controls must be separate and cannot inherit clauses from one another
Shared low-level validation and rendering utilities may be reused without copying business/academic semantics
Ambiguous family authority is a HOLD requesting the owner to choose
All legacy academic URLs remain valid and discoverable through Academic Writing
Website is an index and visualization; private records and authorized compute perform real work
